controller_inspection: player.gd _physics_process directly applies dry gravity, dry horizontal wish and move_and_slide. There is no water mode or external water-velocity hook. No competing controller or in-place modification is introduced.
provided_independent_capabilities: Actual protected river polygon membership and closed centreline arc projection
Four-point unoccupied rigid float immersion forces and velocity drag
Prescribed river game-current field; explicitly not a fluid solver
Source-backed six thermal entry interfaces and visual-only water contact corrections

required_shared_hook.before_move_and_slide: Original player needs a mode-owned water influence interface that changes wish/gravity/buoyancy inside the same controller and retains normal collision/input, support/fall-recovery and stable actor identity. Shared owner controls implementation; no review copy masquerades as the unchanged original.
required_shared_hook.interaction: Original RMB/E resolves admission, mount/dismount, safe occupied/support state and accessible transfer through real continuous motion. No traversal teleport or hidden walking surface.
required_shared_hook.pause_and_save: Original pause/control disabling must interrupt/recover mounted AFK state predictably; persistent actor/float IDs and save schemas require shared owner integration.
required_shared_hook.slides: Slide admission/queue/occupied state, normal physics entry, flume/rider support and runout recovery must attach to the same player mode.

still_required_independent_or_shared: Eight static rack/boarding rings need inventory/launch/dock ownership; no extra production floats spawned by force test.
Water-field current, body mass/draft, hull contact decomposition and species/gravity parameters remain proposals.
Avatar swimming/air, seated pose/support, occupant load/contact and AFK interruption/pause/recovery/save remain unimplemented.
Water-care mechanical controls have no fluid/temperature/cascade simulation; pipe and external service routes remain held interfaces.
50m Grand Pool lane is immutable X-40..-22/Z-457..-407; whole-lane swimming/access/hardware acceptance remains separate.
Shared wet-dry/changing, restaurant cascade/splash/acoustics and ordinary lighting/hardware/final-art acceptance remain open.
